name: MFO S.A.
summary: MFO S.A. is a manufacturer and supplier of steel profiles, distributing its products throughout Poland, across Europe, and to global markets. These adaptable metal sections are integral components in numerous sectors, supporting applications such as uPVC window and roller shutter fabrication, drywall construction, various installations (including ventilation, air conditioning, and electrical), technical flooring systems, the assembly of semi-trailers and truck bodies, furniture production, rack and fencing systems, scaffolding, and photovoltaic energy installations. The company was founded in 2011 and operates from its base in Sochaczew, Poland.
